verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's `npm create cloudflare@latest` CLI (cloudflare-docs-2) and framework support for React, Vue, Svelte, Next, Astro etc. (cloudflare-docs-6) indicate scaffolding from starter templates, and Wrangler docs (cloudflare-docs-11, -20) cover creating/deploying projects. However, the pack lacks explicit evidence of a curated one-click template gallery or 'deploy to Cloudflare' button flow comparable to competitors, and one community note (cloudflare-gh) even flags a showcase project (Wildebeest) being abandoned shortly after launch. Missing for 10: an explicit template/starter gallery page, one-click deploy button UX, and independent hands-on confirmation of ease of using such templates.
